text:
Alex P: Quick sync — we need to lock sprint commitments for the on-prem roadmap customers (AcmeHealth, GovBank). I propose prioritizing: 1) deterministic upgrade path (in-place/blue-green docs + rollback), 2) small-airgap installer, 3) KMS/HSM keys integration. Who's blocked?

Marta G: For upgrades, in-place + DB migration hooks are more realistic for Q2. Blue-green needs infra work (LB rewrites). I can take upgrade operator RFC (RFC-789).

Jordan L: From field: AcmeHealth only accepts zero-downtime for <5min. They asked for canary traffic split and traffic pinning per-tenant.

Samir R: Can do canary routing in the control plane, but needs IP handoff design for private networks. Also need IPAM ideas — GH-4512 has notes.

Anna K: Security asks: KMS-integration must support customer-managed keys + audit logs. Also need FIPS packaging for GovBank.

Alex P: Good. Can we map these to acceptance criteria? Proposed minimum launch criteria:
- documented upgrade path (step-by-step, rollback)
- airgap installer <= 1.2GB
- KMS/HSM support + example integration
- canary routing for tenant pinning
- telemetry + audit log flags for on-prem

Marta G: I'll own the upgrade doc + operator changes. ETA: end of sprint (2 weeks). Need a TOC from product for the doc.

Jordan L: I'll gather customer test cases (AcmeHealth/GovBank) and provide a checklist. Also request: offline eval harness for their test infra.

Samir R: I'll prototype IP handoff pattern and add to GH-4512. Note: NAT traversal from private tenant -> control plane is non-trivial.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: no active deploys to private controlplane. queue=3

Anna K: For FIPS, packaging constraints: must build with specific toolchain. This will add ~2 days to packaging cycle.

Alex P: Tradeoffs noted. Decision for sprint: proceed with In-place upgrade + canary routing, postpone blue-green to follow-up. Product to provide TOC and acceptance tests by EOD tomorrow.

Marta G: Agree. I'll open RFC-operator with checklist and include rollback commands:
```
kubectl apply -f blue-green-controlplane.yaml
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-operator -n redwood
```

Jordan L: Sending customer test matrix and staging creds for AcmeHealth later today.

Samir R: Adding 'ip-handoff-proposal.md' to GH-4512, will ping netops for review.

Alex P: Thanks team. We'll sync Mon 10:30 for final scope cut. @everyone add any blockers to this thread. :thumbsup:
